scope.method: Per-path completed full-read evidence is unioned from exact reader ledgers or source-map coverage tables. Inventory Git blob SHA-1 and byte counts, supplied reader SHA-256 values, and bounded ranges were checked against the locally materialized pinned file. No coverage was inferred from matching hashes alone.

cross_snapshot_coverage.note: All latest-snapshot text paths have direct full-read evidence; no older-main or supporting-repository hash reuse was needed.

binary_assets.limit: Anki fixture tables, rows, note fields, media maps and media bytes were read; small text/blob config cells were read. Binary protobuf config cells were identified by stored type and size but were not decoded into semantic fields.
